'''Shnozitskigante-maximilliana''', known shortly as '''Shnozitski''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was raised by two [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], [[Jaquilinbella-bessamarte]] and [[Rikkimikvonsantikki the Fifty-Fourth]]. Like many of her race venturing beyond their homeworld, [[Shimia/Legends|Shimia]], she wore height-augmenting robo-stilts, although she did not conceal them in shame behind a pair of trousers.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Shnozitski worked as a docking bay attendant on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she met [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who went to Nar Shaddaa to sell his starfighter, the [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']]. Kenobi introduced himself as Ben, and asked Shnozitski to direct him to nearest local market. After receiving several [[Peggat/Legends|Peggats]] from him, the Pacithhip recommended Kenobi to visit [[Paolo's Chop Shop]]. Shnozitski sent a series of holo images of the ''Soulless One'' to Paolo's Chop Shop for a decent referral fee. Immediately after that, she contacted a group of local thugs to rob Kenobi of the payment for the ship for a fifty-one-percent fee. However, the Jedi managed to defeat the attackers, and [[Vima-Da-Boda]] later promised him to punish Shnozitski for her actions.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
